hardcoded-secret.title: Potential secret exposed in source
hardcoded-secret.summary: A scanner identified text that may contain a credential or other sensitive secret.
hardcoded-secret.impact: If the value is active, unauthorized users could access the associated system or data.
remediation_steps: Revoke or rotate the exposed credential using the owning provider.
Remove the secret from source and replace it with an approved secret store or runtime binding.
Check repository history and deployment logs for other exposed copies.

default-security.title: Security condition requires review
default-security.summary: A security scanner identified a condition that may weaken confidentiality, integrity, or availability.
default-security.impact: The practical impact depends on reachable code, inputs, deployment configuration, and available controls.
remediation_steps: Inspect the exact source location and trace relevant inputs and callers.
Apply the scanner or rule documentation guidance after confirming the runtime context.
Add or update a regression test covering the corrected behavior.

default-dependency.title: Dependency or component requires review
default-dependency.summary: A dependency scanner identified a package or component that may need attention.
default-dependency.impact: Impact depends on whether the component is deployed, reachable, and affected by the reported condition.
remediation_steps: Confirm the dependency is used in the deployed artifact and identify the affected path.
Upgrade to a reviewed fixed version or apply the vendor mitigation.
Re-run dependency tests and verify the lockfile and generated artifacts.

default-infrastructure.title: Infrastructure configuration requires review
default-infrastructure.summary: An infrastructure or container rule identified a configuration that may be unsafe or fragile.
default-infrastructure.impact: The condition may increase attack surface or cause insecure deployment behavior if reachable in production.
remediation_steps: Confirm the affected resource and its production exposure.
Apply the least-privilege or hardened configuration recommended by the rule.
Validate the deployment plan and repeat the infrastructure scan.

default-quality.title: Code quality condition requires review
default-quality.summary: A code-quality scanner identified a maintainability, correctness, or style condition.
default-quality.impact: The condition can increase defect risk or make future changes harder to review and test.
remediation_steps: Confirm the finding reflects the intended behavior rather than an accepted project pattern.
Refactor the smallest safe unit and preserve the existing behavior with tests.
Re-run the relevant quality checks before publishing the change.

default-reliability.title: Reliability signal requires review
default-reliability.summary: A reliability or runtime-evidence check identified a condition worth investigating.
default-reliability.impact: The condition may contribute to failures, unsafe edge cases, or reduced operational confidence.
remediation_steps: Reproduce or validate the condition with the relevant test or runtime evidence.
Correct the failure path and add coverage for the observed edge case.
Repeat the check against the exact analyzed revision.

default-advisory.title: Analysis advisory requires review
default-advisory.summary: An advisory source provided a recommendation or observation for developer review.
default-advisory.impact: The impact is context-dependent and is not independently confirmed by this report.
remediation_steps: Review the supporting observation and exact source context.
Validate the recommendation against project requirements and tests.
Record the decision if the recommendation is intentionally not applied.

default-unknown.title: Finding requires developer review
default-unknown.summary: The available scanner metadata does not identify a more specific guidance category.
default-unknown.impact: Potential impact cannot be classified reliably from the retained evidence alone.
remediation_steps: Inspect the scanner message, rule documentation, and exact source location.
Determine whether the condition affects production behavior or security posture.
Add a regression test or document the accepted risk before closing the finding.
